spec.vuln_cue: mentions they lost their job two weeks ago

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Niamh Varga. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Niamh. I can look into it for you. Before we discuss any account details, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. I’ll make sure those fees are returned to you. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: There are three fees from this month. I thought I was within my arranged overdraft, and I lost my job two weeks ago, so it’s hit me pretty hard.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand you’re unhappy about the three unarranged overdraft fees, and I’m sorry for the upset. I’m logging this as a complaint now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I just want someone to check why they’ve been taken.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll take ownership and ask our complaints team to review the charges. You’ll hear back from us within five working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you be the one getting back to me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to the team today, and I’ll make sure they contact you by 31 October. They’ll explain what they find and what happens next.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, so you’re logging it as a complaint and someone will get back to me by the 31st?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ve summarised it as a complaint about the three fees, with the complaints team to review them and contact you by 31 October. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Niamh. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll make sure it’s passed on today.
